Job description:
Academy Kashani is looking for an AI expert proficient in AI tools for the development and practical use of artificial intelligence across various departments of the group. Responsibilities: Identifying AI applications in various departments of the group, setting up and implementing AI tools for the prompt design team and custom assistants for various units, automating repetitive tasks and internal processes, educating staff on the use of AI, reviewing and introducing new and useful AI tools, using AI to increase the speed and quality of content creation, sales, support, and administrative affairs, designing simple systems to reduce manual work, documenting the methods for using tools and created systems. Expected skills: Professional mastery of ChatGPT and AI tools, familiarity with building GPT/Agents and intelligent assistants, familiarity with automation tools like n8n or Make is considered an advantage, ability to quickly research and learn new tools, analytical and problem-solving mind, ability to train other team members on tools. We are not just looking for someone who has "worked with ChatGPT." We are looking for someone who can investigate how a group can work faster, more cost-effectively, and smarter using AI, and then practically implement these solutions. Submitting samples of work or explanations of projects executed with artificial intelligence has a significant impact on the resume review.

Company description:
We have been providing online education for 4 years at Kashani Academy. We believe that your dream of a virtual business should be more than one night's sleep. With our comprehensive and practical courses, we accompany you from zero to one hundred in setting up and managing your virtual business.
